segments.title: October
segments.text: Hello Kemps Corner! October is the Festival of Lights. Dhanteras, Diwali, gifting season, and a lot of very good sweets. This month, we sell sparkle: upgrades, gifts, and a golden annual membership that lasts longer than any box of kaju katli.

segments.title: ₹50.2L
segments.text: So, the number. Our October target for Kemps Corner is 50.2 lakh rupees. That's 91 per cent up on last October. A stretch, but a friendly one.

segments.title: 4 streams
segments.text: Where does it come from? Renewals lead the way with 27.6 lakh rupees. That's 6 of every 10 rupees. Then new clients 12 lakh, comebacks 6.02 lakh, and everything else 4.52 lakh. Our existing members carry this month, so every renewal conversation matters.

segments.title: 108 buyers
segments.text: Behind the number are people: 786 leads, 401 trials, and 108 buyers, with about 27 per cent of trials converting. The trial class is where this month is won. Warm welcome, clear next step, every time.

Here's where the offers come in. Four offers carry 23.5 lakh rupees, which is 47 per cent of our target. The rest comes from full-price sales, so the offers are a boost, not a crutch. Let's meet them.

segments.title: From Phuljhadi to Anaar
segments.text: First up, From Phuljhadi to Anaar. Monthly members upgrade to six months at twenty per cent off, with three extra freezes for the festive madness. Small sparkle to big sparkle. The plan is 18 buyers at about 65,000, so 11.7 lakh rupees.
segments.notes: Members on 1 Month or class packs.

segments.title: Diwali Gifting, Minus the Dry-Fruit Box
segments.text: Next, Diwali Gifting, Minus the Dry-Fruit Box. Gift three classes for the price of two. If the recipient joins, the giver earns a bonus class. Nobody needs a fourteenth box of almonds. The plan is 30 buyers at about 3,900, so 1.17 lakh rupees.

segments.title: Diwali Cleaning: Found Your Old Grip Socks?
segments.text: Then, for lapsed members, Diwali Cleaning. Found your old grip socks? That's a sign. Fifteen per cent off the return, and a brand-new pair of socks on us. The plan is 22 buyers at about 17,200, so 3.78 lakh rupees.

segments.title: Gold Rush (Dhanteras Edition)
segments.text: And finally, for Dhanteras, Gold Rush. An annual at twenty-two per cent off, an extra private, and a gold-foil card, for seventy-two hours only. Gold that actually lifts. The plan is 4 buyers at about 1.71 lakh, so 6.85 lakh rupees.

segments.title: 4 weeks
segments.text: How does the month run? Week one, every monthly member hears the anaar upgrade pitch. Week two, gift cards go live at the desk, online and in office inboxes. Week three, Dhanteras, and the gold annual for seventy-two hours only. Week four, Diwali cleaning brings old members home.

segments.title: That's the plan
segments.text: That's October at Kemps Corner. 50.2 lakh rupees, four offers, and 108 buyers to welcome. Lights on, targets lit. Happy Diwali.
